SCE is proposing to replace the NPDES regulated discharge into Big Creek with a land discharge that includes a combination effluent subsurface dispersal system (Ieachfield) and land application (spray fields) system.
The proposed disposal systems (leach field and spray fields) will be northeast of the WWTF.
Solids collected by the brush screen and 'grit chamber are placed into a dumpster and disposed of offsite.
Effluent use for the proposed spray field will be chlorinated in addition to disinfection with ultra violet light.
